lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr₂Fe₄O₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 14-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors at about 1.90–2.03 Å, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (one Fe, three Sr). Sr centers display a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. The Fe octahedra share corners and edges with one another and with Sr 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
